watches.name: Challenger Automatic Steel Aqua
watches.description: The Challenger Automatic was created with modern supercars in mind. These high performance luxury cars feature unique, colorful rim design, which we drew inspiration from for the Challenger’s time display. The hour, minute, and second hands continually shift to create new shapes and patterns throughout your day, while still telling the time legibly. It’s essentially a kinetic sculpture for your wrist. SPECIFICATIONS Movement: PTS 27D0A, 20 Jewels, 21600 BPH, Up to 36 Hour Power Reserve. Made in China. Accuracy: -20/+40 sec per day Functions: Hours, Minutes, Central Seconds Case: Hand-finished 316L Stainless Steel Crystal: Hardened Mineral Water Resistance: 3 ATM Dimensions: 42mm Wide. 10.8mm ThickLug to Lug: 46mm Strap: 20mm Smooth Leather w/ Tool-free, Quick-release Springbar System Wrist Circumference: 5.75-8” (140mm/210mm) Weight: 2.29 oz (65 grams)

watches.name: Caspian Automatic Rose Gold Silver Brown
watches.description: We always cut away the dials so you can see the oscillating balance wheel while you wear your watch. We’ve taken that up a notch with the Caspian Automatic by showcasing dual balance wheels - a first for Archetype. The two balance wheels are surrounded by a beautifully textured, guilloche-style baseplate. The time telling dial features two stamped textures and classic Roman numerals hour markers which is all elevated above the balance wheels and baseplate. An embossed-croc leather strap with stainless steel traditional tang buckle complement the guilloche dial details for a refined look. SPECIFICATIONS Movement: PTS JHL-S33 Double Balance, 47 Jewels, 21600 BPH, Up to 36 Hour Power Reserve. Made in China. Accuracy: -20/+40 sec per day Functions: Hours, Minutes Case: Hand-finished 316L Stainless Steel Crystal: Hardened Mineral Dimensions: 45mm Wide. 12mm Thick Lug to Lug: 52mm Water Resistance: 3 ATM Strap: 22mm Croc-stamped Leather w/ Tool-free, Quick-release Springbar System Wrist Circumference: 5.75-8” (140mm/210mm) Weight: 2.78 oz (79 grams)
